The high-contrast finish between the mirror-polished display surface and the rugged, natural exterior showcases the raw geological beauty of the native copper.
Natural float copper ore construction with high-gloss polished display faces
Significant weight and density provides excellent stability for supporting large volumes
Natural raw texture preserved on the reverse and sides showcasing original matrix stone

description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray, Ohio Valley Glass Co. (O.V.G. Co.)
Aqua and Teal Green, Vintage
Collection of three vintage glass insulators originally utilized for telegraph and telephone line insulation. This lot features insulators from prominent American manufacturers, showcasing the industrial aqua and teal green glass common to early 20th-century utility production. These heavy pressed glass pieces are sought after for their historical industrial aesthetic and display appeal.
Pieces Included:
Insulator, Aqua, marked "O.V.G. CO." - features a large chip on the side and base
Insulator, Teal Green, marked "N 21" - internal vertical crack visible on the crown
Insulator, Aqua/Teal, marked "HEMINGRAY" - exhibits surface scratching and minor flea bites
Condition:
The lot is in damaged vintage condition as noted and photographed. One insulator has a significant chip loss on the lower body. A second piece shows a distinct crack through the glass dome. The Hemingray piece retains its shape but shows signs of outdoor weathering and light surface wear. Recommended for rustic decor or craft projects.

description:
Mineral Specimen Collection - Mixed Lot
Quartz, Calcite, and Various Natural Stones
Natural Geological Specimens
This collection features a variety of natural geological specimens, anchored by a significant large white geode with a visible crystalline interior. These pieces offer a range of textures, from raw, jagged mineral clusters to smooth tumbled accent stones, making them ideal for display, geological study, or as a foundational set for a mineral collection. The diverse array of colors and formations provides a comprehensive look at common mineral structures including druzy quartz and calcite cleavage planes.
Pieces Included:
Large white quartz geode, approximately 6.5 inches tall with hollow crystalline center
Medium raw mineral specimens (2) featuring layered crystal structures and earthy inclusions
Yellow raw and tumbled stones (4) with vibrant saturation
Green tumbled stone (1) with semi-translucent appearance
Clear and smoky mineral accent pieces (multiple) in various sizes
White flat mineral slab (1) with matte finish
Condition:
Natural geological specimens in raw and tumbled states. The large geode is intact as a specimen half with well-defined internal crystals. Smaller pieces show typical natural variations, inclusions, and fractures inherent to mineral formations. No significant modern damage beyond natural extraction characteristics. Total collection weight is 5.14 pounds.
Warehouse Location: Cleveland
Due to our lighting, white glare lines may appear on items - This is NOT damage
If you have any questions regarding the quality or authenticity of this item or general questions regarding and item, please click Contact Seller on the item page and send us a message. We are available to answer your questions Monday through Friday, 8 am - 3:00 pm, EST.

When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.

Hemingray Glass Company
No. 12 Insulator
Pressed Glass, Aqua Blue, Antique/Vintage
Authentic Hemingray No. 12 glass insulator, a classic piece of American industrial history. Produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, this model was widely used for telephone and telegraph lines during the late 19th and early 20th centuries. It features the signature aqua blue glass and technical design elements common to the era's utility infrastructure.
Embossed "HEMINGRAY NO. 12" on the front skirt
Embossed "PATENT MAY 2 1893" on the reverse side
Sharp drip points along the bottom base edge designed to shed moisture
Translucent aqua blue glass with characteristic manufacturing seed bubbles and swirls
Approximately 3.75 inches tall by 3 inches wide
Condition:

description: This lot includes four vintage used vacuum tubes from National brand: 2C39 and 7289 models. Made in the USA, these tubes feature metal and ceramic construction. They were typically used as radio frequency power amplifiers in industrial, military, and amateur radio equipment. Tubes show signs of wear and oxidation, with handwritten notes on bases indicating previous use and condition, such as 'R. Final 2C39 5-20-85 USED' and '+V.G.++'. All tubes appear structurally intact but are sold as used and may require testing or refurbishment before operational use. Suitable for collectors, restorers, or those needing period-correct replacements for vintage RF or transmitter gear. not tested
